items.title: The pavements both sides of Limber Hill are appalling. Reported before and just saw two men marking three tiny areas fixed. I said to them to look at the state of the pavements, which consist now mainly of small stones, not tarmac and they grinned and said don't fit criteria of depth. These are now dangerous pavements especially to the elderly of whom I am one. Will someone who can talk sense and admit the pavements need completely resurfacing. I have lived here for 47 years and have got nowhere. All the Council tax I have paid and you completely ignore me. Please take this seriously. Three little patches will not do.
